def execute_object_detector(image_path, labels=["baseball", "basket"], threshold=0.35, model_size="tiny", save_object=True, saved_image_path="detected_objects"):
    import_object_detector = Object_Detector_Tool()
    results = import_object_detector.execute(image_path, labels=labels, threshold=threshold, save_object=save_object, saved_image_path=saved_image_path)

    # Calculate the object number
    detected_objects = {}
    for label in results[0]:
        detected_objects[label["label"]] = {"num": label["num"]}

    # Calculate the total object number
    object_number = sum(detected_objects.values())

    return detected_objects, object_number
